cut: v1 stills (30 Oct): RFH global/Coxon, papercut, VIRAL cut. Anthropic's S-1 (public 26 Oct 2026): two of its investors are also its biggest computing suppliers, with minimum commitments owed whether or not the computing is used. Frame 0 is money bags dropping from two towers into Anthropic's box; the end is the same money going back round the loop. The disclosure tag (MADE WITH ANTHROPIC'S TOOLS) is on the hook; its wording is the owner's to approve.
argument: Doodle (Google) and Amazon invested in Anthropic; its IPO filing shows it must buy at least $114.5B of computing from Doodle and $110B from Amazon, owed even if unused, so the investors' money comes back to them as payments. No wrongdoing is claimed.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

disclosure.why: owner, 23 Oct: a film on Anthropic says on screen that it was made with Anthropic's tools; the owner approves the wording (pending)

towers.en: two cut-card data-centre towers: DOODLE (the Doodle wordmark in its colours, the house parody of Google) and AMAZON (plain type, no logo)
towers.why: house convention: Google appears as Doodle; Amazon is named plainly; no real logos

box.en: a cream card box labelled ANTHROPIC in plain type; no logo
box.why: the company is named plainly, as any other company would be

money.en: cut-card money bags and coins; compute as small chip cards
money.why: the money and the computing as objects; amounts are on tags, never on the props

loop.en: a dashed track with arrowheads round the three, the money riding it
loop.why: the station's line, the round trip, drawn: no wrongdoing claimed

captions.source: Anthropic's S-1 (public 26 Oct 2026) says Amazon and Google will each hold more than 5% of its stock after conversion, in non-voting Class N shares (as reported by Bernama and The Next Web, citing the filing; share counts are blank in this version). Doodle is the station's parody of Google.

text.en: Its IPO filing: / it must pay them / for [computing].
text.ja: 上場申請書では / 両社に [計算資源]の / 支払い義務。

captions.source: The S-1 lists minimum compute commitments to Google, Amazon and Microsoft (GeekWire; Motley Fool 29 Oct; ppc.land; all citing the filing). The filing itself could not be opened from this session (EDGAR blocked by the proxy).

text.en: At least [$114.5B] / to Doodle, / $110B to Amazon.
text.ja: Doodleに / [1145億ドル]以上、 / Amazonに / 1100億ドル。

captions.source: GeekWire and Motley Fool (29 Oct), on the S-1: minimums of at least $114.5B to Google (Apr 2026 to Jul 2033) and at least $110.0B to Amazon (May 2026 to Apr 2036). Reuters' earlier $111.1B for Google came from the June confidential draft. Microsoft's minimum ($44.9B) is in the post copy, not on screen: Microsoft's stake is not confirmed here.

text.ja: 使わなくても / [支払う] 義務。

captions.source: Reported from the S-1: the Google and Amazon commitments are payable regardless of actual usage; if spend falls short Anthropic generally pays the difference, subject to contractual adjustments (GeekWire; Motley Fool; ppc.land). To be quoted only from the filing itself.
The station's line, true as stated: the two investors are also the suppliers the filing commits Anthropic to pay. No wrongdoing is claimed; the structure is the story.

sumTag.ja: 最低購入額・報道による

post.en: Doodle and Amazon invested in Anthropic. Its IPO filing commits it to buy at least $114.5B of computing from Doodle and $110B from Amazon, owed even if unused (and $44.9B from Microsoft). Made with Anthropic's tools. Who's paying whom?
post.fi: Doodle ja Amazon sijoittivat Anthropiciin. Sen pörssiesite sitoo sen ostamaan laskentaa vähintään 114,5 mrd $:lla Doodlelta ja 110 mrd $:lla Amazonilta, maksettava vaikka jäisi käyttämättä (ja 44,9 mrd $:lla Microsoftilta). Tehty Anthropicin työkaluilla. Kuka maksaa kenelle?
post.ja: DoodleとAmazonはAnthropicに出資。その上場申請書によると、Doodleから1145億ドル以上、Amazonから1100億ドルの計算資源を買う義務があり、使わなくても支払う（Microsoftには449億ドル）。Anthropicのツールで制作。誰が誰に払っている？
